Who is at the top of the organization (i.e.,  reports to no one).
SELECT firstname, lastname AS top_manager FROM employees WHERE reportsto IS NULL;	----- bird -----	classicmodels
List all the products purchased by Herkku Gifts.

SELECT DISTINCT p.productname FROM customers AS c JOIN orders AS o ON o.customernumber = c.customernumber JOIN orderdetails AS od ON od.ordernumber = o.ordernumber JOIN products AS p ON p.productcode = od.productcode WHERE c.customername = 'Herkku Gifts';	----- bird -----	classicmodels
What is the value of payments received in July 2004?
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_payments_july_2004 FROM payments WHERE paymentdate >= '2004-07-01' AND paymentdate < '2004-08-01';	----- bird -----	classicmodels
List the names of products sold at less than 80% of the MSRP.
SELECT p.productname FROM products AS p WHERE p.buyprice IS NOT NULL AND p.msrp IS NOT NULL AND p.buyprice < p.msrp * 0.8;	----- bird -----	classicmodels
Report total payments for Atelier graphique.

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total_payments FROM payments AS p JOIN customers AS c ON p.customernumber = c.customernumber WHERE c.customername = 'Atelier graphique';	----- bird -----	classicmodels
Report the products that have not been sold.
SELECT p.productcode, p.productname FROM products AS p LEFT JOIN orderdetails AS od ON p.productcode = od.productcode WHERE od.productcode IS NULL;	----- bird -----	classicmodels
How many orders have been placed by Herkku Gifts?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM orders JOIN customers ON orders.customernumber = customers.customernumber WHERE customers.customername = 'Herkku Gifts';	----- bird -----	classicmodels
Who are the employees in Boston?
SELECT e.firstname, e.lastname FROM employees AS e JOIN offices AS o ON e.officecode = o.officecode WHERE o.city = 'Boston';	----- bird -----	classicmodels
List the value of 'On Hold' orders.
SELECT o.`ordernumber` FROM orders AS o WHERE o.`status` = 'On Hold';	----- bird -----	classicmodels
Find products containing the name 'Ford'.
SELECT productname FROM products WHERE productname LIKE '%Ford%';	----- bird -----	classicmodels
List products ending in 'ship'.
SELECT productname FROM products WHERE productname LIKE '%ship';	----- bird -----	classicmodels
Report the number of customers in Denmark, Norway, and Sweden.
SELECT country, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM customers WHERE country IN ('Denmark', 'Norway', 'Sweden') GROUP BY country;	----- bird -----	classicmodels
What are the products with a product code in the range S700_1000 to S700_1499?
SELECT p.productcode, p.productname FROM products AS p WHERE p.productcode BETWEEN 'S700_1000' AND 'S700_1499';	----- bird -----	classicmodels
List the products containing ship or boat in their product name.
SELECT DISTINCT productname FROM products WHERE LOWER(productname) LIKE '%ship%' OR LOWER(productname) LIKE '%boat%';	----- bird -----	classicmodels
List the products with a product code beginning with S700.
SELECT p.productcode, p.productname FROM products AS p WHERE p.productcode LIKE 'S700%';	----- bird -----	classicmodels
List the names of employees called Larry or Barry.
SELECT firstname, lastname AS name FROM employees WHERE firstname IN ('Larry', 'Barry');	----- bird -----	classicmodels
List the vendors whose name ends in Diecast.
SELECT DISTINCT productvendor FROM products WHERE productvendor LIKE '%Diecast';	----- bird -----	classicmodels
How many employees are there in the company?
SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_employees FROM employees;	----- bird -----	classicmodels
What is the total of payments received?
SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_payments FROM payments;	----- bird -----	classicmodels
List the product lines that contain 'Cars'.
SELECT DISTINCT `productline` FROM productlines WHERE `productline` LIKE '%Cars%'	----- bird -----	classicmodels
Report total payments for October 28, 2004.
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_payments FROM payments WHERE date(paymentdate) = '2004-10-28';	----- bird -----	classicmodels
Report those payments greater than $100,000.
SELECT checknumber, paymentdate, amount, customernumber FROM payments WHERE amount > 100000;	----- bird -----	classicmodels
How many products in each product line?
SELECT productline, COUNT(*) AS product_count FROM products GROUP BY productline;	----- bird -----	classicmodels
What is the minimum payment received?
SELECT MIN(p.amount) AS min_payment FROM payments AS p;	----- bird -----	classicmodels
List all payments greater than twice the average payment.
SELECT checknumber, amount FROM payments WHERE amount > 2 * (SELECT AVG(amount) FROM payments);	----- bird -----	classicmodels
How many distinct products does ClassicModels sell?
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT productcode) AS num_distinct_products FROM products;	----- bird -----	classicmodels
